content.value: An experiment reported in popular science compared fuel economics for two types of (13) similarity equipped diesel mini-trucks. Let us suppose that 12 Volkswager and 10 Toyota trucks are used in 90 km per hour steady-spaced tasks. If the 12 Volkswager trucks average 16 km per liter with a standard deviation of 1 km per liter and 10 Toyota trucks average 11 km per liter with a standard deviation of 0.8 km per liter, construct a 90% confidence interval for difference between the average km per liter of these two mini trucks.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
